1.why: All visible text uses a clean legible sans-serif typeface with adequate spacing, though letter and line spacing appear standard rather than notably generous.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks appear anywhere in the four screens; all copy is short sentence-case lines.

3.why: The single-column layout is readable and well proportioned at mobile width, but the dark 'Logs' panel overlaps the lower content area.

4.why: The instructions present ('Confirm your account details before setting up payment security.') are short and plain, though overall guidance is very sparse.

5.why: Placeholders show concrete examples of expected input ('marcus@example.com', '+15551234567'), reinforced by the note to use the details shown.

6.why: No long block of text appears on any screen; the longest copy is two short lines.

7.why: No codes or secrets are ever displayed and no copy affordance exists, because the flow never advanced past the sign-in form.

8.why: No QR code or manual-entry alternative is shown; the authenticator setup step was never reached in any screenshot.

9.why: Autofill and password-manager support cannot be confirmed from the screenshots; the inputs are standard types but there is no password field or explicit evidence.

10.why: The 'Sign in to continue' heading, breadcrumb, and large blue Continue button make the step and primary action clear, though there is no explicit step indicator.

11.why: The only action requested on every screen is to confirm the two fields and press Continue.

12.why: After submitting, the system only shows the generic banner 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.', which neither explains what happened nor what comes next.

13.why: Retry is possible without lockout across steps 2–4, but no reveal/hide/re-request code controls exist and every retry fails identically.

14.why: The error message is non-blaming but does not state the problem at all, offering only the vague instruction 'Please try again.'

15.why: No timers or time limits are visible on any screen, but code entry was never reached so the generosity of code-entry time cannot be verified.
